statements.t: We do not provide forward-looking guidance for certain financial measures on a GAAP basis because we are unable to predict certain items contained in the GAAP measures without unreasonable efforts.

As of October 3, 2026, Brunswick was in compliance with the financial covenants associated with its debt and based on our anticipated earnings generation throughout the year, we expect to maintain sufficient cushion against the existing debt covenants.
The Company anticipates at least $160 million of debt reduction, $200 million of capital expenditures, and share repurchases of at least $80 million for the year.

estimates.t: There were no material changes in our critical accounting policies since the filing of our 2025 Form 10-K.

statements.t: Mercury’s five major new outboard development programs remain on track and further reinforce our confidence in the long-term growth of the business.

Finally, we continued to execute our disciplined capital allocation strategy including further debt reduction and share repurchases, buying back $75 million of shares year-to-date, while remaining on track to meet or exceed our debt retirement target and maintain a strong balance sheet.
